newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Suspected N.Korean vessel spotted in S.Korea-TV.
newsitem.headline: Suspected N.Korean vessel spotted in S.Korea-TV.

text.p: An unidentified vessel, suspected of coming from North Korea, was spotted near a South Korean beach where a Northern submarine ran aground last September, Yonhap Television News reported on Tuesday.
Yonhap, quoting local police, said the two-tonne boat was found near the east coast city of Kangnung.
Aboard the craft was a note praising North Korean leader Kim Jong-il, the television said. There was no word on whether the vessel had landed any people.
A defence ministry official said he had no knowledge of the reported incident.

The submarine that intruded last year landed 26 infiltrators, 24 of whom were shot and killed during a massive manhunt. Pyongyang apologised for the incursion last week and promised not to do it again.
